maintainers: tabs inside a dropdown are documented as unsupported because they cannot map to an ARIA tab pattern; the last-good construct is not accessible (DR-0063)
no user-facing symptom: 1.6 moved the live region to the Toaster section (aria-live=polite), so toasts are still announced (DR-0063)

no library fix: maintainers call it an edge case of an unidiomatic ref pattern (regression from #17299) and recommend a different usage; the issue's pattern did not reproduce either (DR-0063)

symptom ambiguous between focus movement and focus visibility (the issue's own check is the tooltip's focus border, and the fix also restored focus styles lost in a bad merge), and the fix changed the recommended markup, so no release pair follows from the issue alone (DR-0063)
